jobs.title: Implementation Specialist 1
jobs.description:
At Colibri, culture is a critical part of our collective success, and we live our values everyday: Love, Joy,

Boldness, Teamwork and Curiosity. These values guide our interactions with each other, our customers,

and the community as a whole.

We have a rich and storied history. Colibri is one of the pioneers of online professional education,

introducing some of the first web-based professional education courses in 2001. Today, the company’s

family of brands are the leading online professional education platforms in their respective end-markets.

We proudly serve >1 million customers annually and employ more than 1,500 mission-aligned

professionals. To learn more, please visit: www.colibrigroup.com

**Overview:**  
The Implementation Specialist I role is primarily responsible for developing and implementing course content. The position will work within cross-functional project teams to build and deliver innovative print and/or digital course materials for the professional and higher education markets. The Implementation Specialist may work with proprietary course builder software, established content development software, content management systems and learning management systems. Utilizing templates, guidelines, and established processes, this role will work across product lines in a matrixed, deadline-driven environment to produce innovation and engaging material for our students. This position may also contribute to the support and maintenance requests to meet the team’s required service level contracts with clients.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**  

* Develops and updates course content materials according to the specifications, standards, and guidelines of the project with oversight from a senior level position.
* Formats content per project design specifications.
* Maintains course and academic content in established storage systems and databases using Institutional protocols, processes and procedures.

Effectively operates in a team environment, collaborating with Course Development team members during course development.  

* May prepare PDF files and deliverables for print vendors, internal stakeholders, and partners as needed.
* Actively participates on project teams in assisting with planning, scheduling, and problem solving.

Effectively utilizes appropriate technology such as authoring tools, production software, content management system, digital asset system, learning management system and other technical tools/software applications used within the organization as required.  

* Completes other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**  
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.  

* Bachelor’s degree in Instructional Design, Instructional Technology, Graphic Arts, or a related area (e.g., publishing; education)
* 1-2 years of experience building online courses in a fast-paced environment
* Expertise creating complex content in PowerPoint is required
* Expertise working in InDesign to created printed textbook files strongly preferred
* Experience building courses in Articulate Rise/Storyline preferred
* Experience with graphic design is a plus
* Proven ability to manage multiple assignments simultaneously and prioritize effectively
* Ability to work in a fast paced team environment-both as an individual contributor and as a collaborative member of the team
* Ability to learn and implement new technologies and adapt processes for continuous improvement, particularly by using AI tools such as Copilot or Claude
* Strong communication and organizational skills
* A positive attitude is key!

Colibri Group welcomes applicants from all backgrounds and experiences, and we understand that not every candidate will meet every requirement listed in the job description. Research has shown that women and people of color may be less likely to apply to jobs unless they feel they meet every qualification, and we want to actively combat this bias in our hiring process. If you're excited about the role and believe you have the skills and experience to contribute to our team, we encourage you to apply, even if your background doesn't align perfectly with every qualification listed. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we believe that diversity of perspectives and experiences is essential to our success. You may be just the right candidate for this role or another position within our organization. Don't hesitate to take the leap and apply today!

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Clinical Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

  
  

**Position Summary**

  

The Clinical Implementation Specialist is responsible for providing external business clients with technical support with the implementation of their application software, software solutions, and hardware. The Clinical Implementation Specialist is also responsible for providing software configuration against defined user requirements and specifications. The Implementation Specialist works in partnership with the development team to ensure all application software and software solutions are implemented to meet business client and project expectations.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

  

The essential duties and responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to the following:

* Work directly with clients as a clinical expert and an essential member of the project team

* Apply clinical knowledge and expertise to guide clients in the necessary system clinical workflow to satisfy and possibly exceed current requirements

* Use knowledge of clinical standards to recommend appropriate system set-up to clients

* Apply technical and operational knowledge and expertise to perform software and integration testing of implemented software systems and solutions

* Resolve identified issues requiring changes to implemented software applications and solutions

* Develop scripts (test cases) for newly implemented software applications and solutions

* Work closely with the development team in gathering and reviewing business client feedback and assist in writing user requirement documents

* Work closely with engineering resources to define requirements for product changes

* Contribute to the development of and tracking against project plans around project progress, milestones and targeted implementation date

* Identify risks that could impact the business client’s stated business objectives and develop risk mitigation plans to manage the risk with the development and implementation teams

* Ensure all business client communication and documentation is recorded in appropriate repositories to maintain product documentation

* Test and troubleshoot final system implementations

* Provide training and end-user support during and after the implementation process

Other duties and/or projects as assigned

  
  

### **Requirements**

  
  

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Certification in area of clinical expertise, such as LCSW, LMSW, LMHC, LPN, and others.
* Bachelor’s degree that supports clinical expertise
* 5 years professional work experience in a behavioral healthcare environment, including in-depth experience using an EHR platform
* Strong working knowledge of Information Technology, software solutions, and software management systems
Ability to travel up to 25% as needed  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

Master's degree in a Clinical Profession  

  

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Demonstrated ability to use effective and results-oriented problem solving and critical thinking skills; strong troubleshooting ability
* Demonstrated ability to use strong analytical skills
* Effective interpersonal and people skills
* Ability to juggle multiple tasks, establish and manage competing priorities, work independently and be proactive and perform effectively under
* pressure
* Ability to anticipate issues and risk and work proactively to develop alternatives to meet project goals and objectives
* Strong and effective communication skills (verbal and written)
* Pays very close attention to detail
Ability to work independently and within a team environment  

  
  

### **Benefits**

  
  

**Fully Remote Workforce**

As a virtual-first organization, we can attract the best talent no matter where we all live. This allows for added flexibility and a schedule that works for you.

  

**Employee Recognition**

Team members can reward each other with points to celebrate everyday wins and going above and beyond. It’s our way of saying “nice job” in a way that really sticks.

  

**Financial Incentives**

Employees can benefit financially through the company’s success, referring top talent, and performance-based bonuses.

  
  

**Salary**: $85,000 - $100,000

We are not able to offer visa sponsorships at this time.

jobs.title: Customer Success & Implementation Specialist- Remote anywhere in CA
jobs.description:
**What We Do:**

KinderSystems (www.KinderSystems.com) is the leading provider of subsidy management software-as-a-service (SaaS) solutions to state agencies, Head Start programs, and child care providers. Built and supported by industry experts, KinderSystems envisions a world where all families, no matter their income level, have access to high quality child care. Hundreds of agencies in the publicly funded child care sector use KinderSystems applications via the cloud or mobile devices to streamline their operations, ensure compliance with government regulations, and meet the needs of the families they serve.

**What you’ll do with us:**

As a Customer Success & Implementation Specialist with KinderSystems, you will work in a dual role: half of your time will be spent successfully onboarding new customers through their implementation, and the other half will be spent providing high-quality, first-line customer service and technical support via telephone, Zoom/Teams, email, and chat to our California customers. We are looking for candidates that are enthusiastic about caring for our customers and have the aptitude for troubleshooting technical issues with software. This position requires strong attention to details, patience, and a customer-focused mindset.

**At this time we are only accepting applications from candidates who are located in the pacific, mountain, or central time zone, with preference given to candidates who are located in California.**

  

**How we’ll keep you busy:**

* Implementations: You will be responsible for owning the entire implementation and onboarding of a new customer:
  + Host a kick-off call with the customer to define roles and expectations.
  + Schedule and facilitate user training.
  + Serve as first point of contact for questions through implementation. Once the customer is live with the software, they will transition to Customer Support and Success.
* Customer Success:
  + Answer calls, emails and chats from our existing customers in a fast-paced environment, helping to resolve issues and answer questions.
  + Troubleshooting technical issues to determine if there is a system issue, and report issues to our development team
  + Accurately document and process customer claims in appropriate systems
  + Appropriately escalate customer issues to the CA Customer Success Team Lead
  + Ensure first call resolution through problems solving and effective call handling
  + Attend meetings and training and review all new training material to stay up to date on changes

**Who you are**

* Strong interpersonal communication skills. This includes writing, presentation, and verbal communication skills with both internal and external customers. You work well with, and enjoy technology. You are comfortable training customers on software, but also know how to problem solve and de-escalate a call when a customer is having technical issues.
* Highly motivated, independent, and self-driven. You have an eye for details and are incredibly organized and able to transition between responsibilities quickly.
* Able to use documentation tools, training tools, and design tools.
* Training certifications and/or prior experience facilitating training is a plus.
* Experience in the use of standard Microsoft operating systems (including Outlook, Excel and PowerPoint). Database systems, and applications programs helpful.
* Able to travel throughout the state for customer engagements and conferences.

**What We Offer**

* The ability to work from anywhere in California, with approximately 10% travel (California based)
* Compensation for this role is $22-$23/hour
* Comprehensive benefits package including health, vision, and dental insurance, starting the first of the month after start date
* 401(k) retirement plan, with company match
* Paid company holidays and generous PTO
* Friendly, supportive, and adventurous environment with a team of engaged colleagues who are all focused on enabling and improving the child care industry for all families

KinderSystems actively embraces diversity and equal opportunity in a meaningful way. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be which is why we do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist, US (Remote)
jobs.description:
#### **Your Mission**

###### **Implementation Specialist, US (Remote)**

###### Implementation Specialists are the difference between a customer’s first weeks with Linnworks and a lifetime of loyalty. You’ll join a tight-knit team of Implementation Specialists and Project Managers who turn ambitious onboarding plans into real, working systems — fast. Expect to think on your feet, test bold ideas, and iterate until you’ve found the formula that clicks for each customer. It’s part strategist, part technologist, part storyteller — and entirely driven by the belief that a great first experience changes everything. *We're looking for someone genuinely curious — always testing new ideas, comfortable challenging their own assumptions, and driven to find a better way of doing things.*

*Linnworks product experience is a plus but not required — full product training is provided on the job.*

***Applicants must live in either Eastern or Central US Time zones***

**What you’ll do:**

* Lead discovery and configuration across channels, inventory, shipping and automation
* Help clients clean up and import product and order data (CSV/XLSX)
* Troubleshoot integration issues and escalate with clear, reproducible detail
* Keep projects on track in Salesforce, and write documentation clients can use after go-live
* Feed client patterns back to Product, Sales, Engineering, and the wider team

**Attitudes:**

* Trustworthy & responsible, flexible, stress-tolerant
* Helpful attitude, capable of asking and accepting help when needed
* Quick learner, naturally curious, and always testing new ideas
* Continuous-improvement mindset: comfortable challenging your own assumptions to find a better way of doing things
* Entrepreneurial mindset: self-motivated, resourceful, innovative, collaborative and committed
* A proactive, problem-solving mindset

**Knowledge:**

* Understanding of project and task management
* Curiosity about how order/inventory management and e-commerce operations work end-to-end — you don't need to be an expert on day one, you'll build this knowledge on the job

#### **What You'll Bring To The Role**

* Track record of strong performance in a previous role
* At least 6–12 months in a customer-facing role (e.g. ecommerce operations, customer support, onboarding/implementation, account management, or product/development)
* Preferred: experience with Linnworks or a similar order/inventory management platform (OMS, PIM, ERP, marketplace, or fulfilment), or a background in e-commerce, SaaS, or a cloud application environment
* Technically minded, with a basic understanding of APIs and how systems connect and exchange data
* AI-curious rather than an AI expert: you don't need to arrive as an AI power-user, but you're keen to explore how AI-assisted tools (e.g. Claude, Fellow) can drive efficiency in documentation, meeting notes, and day-to-day work
* Experience with Salesforce (CRM), Asana (project management), and other standard Office applications
* Good understanding of working with and manipulating data in CSV and Excel (XLSX) files
* A natural teacher. You can explain complex systems to non-technical users, check they’ve understood, and adjust your approach when something isn’t landing
* Excellent written and verbal English language skills
* Confident, clear communicator — comfortable running customer calls, status updates, and internal presentations
* Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize and switch between tasks under pressure
* Decision-making and strategic thinking skills
* Ability to work effectively as part of a team, including distributed, cross-time-zone teams and customers
* Experience training, coaching or enabling others (customer training, support, retail or warehouse team leads, teaching). Formal or informal both count
* Experience with an Order Management System (OMS), Product Information Management (PIM), ERP, ecommerce marketplace/storefront (e.g. Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, TikTok Shop, WooCommerce), or fulfilment platform — or broader e-commerce sector experience — is strongly preferred

**Heads up: our application emails sometimes land in spam, so please check your junk folder.**

#### **Why us?**

We embrace diversity and inclusion and encourage our amazing team members to bring their authentic, fun selves to work every day. We offer a culture of innovation, mutual respect, support, and transparency. The competitive and comprehensive benefits our team members enjoy are designed to ensure you and your family members are healthy.

* 401(k) Plan with employer match
* Generous medical, dental and vision plans
* Flexible spending, dependent care, and health savings accounts
* Short-Term and Long Term Disability
* Life Insurance and AD&D Insurance
* Health and Wellness Initiatives
* Workplace Flexibility
* 20 days Paid time off
* 10 Company Holidays
* 14 Sick Days
* 2 Volunteer Days
* Team Member Referral Program

#### **About us**

As the global leader in the eCommerce automation sector, Linnworks has one mission: Giving our clients back their time to grow and lead their brands. Companies wanting to sell their products via marketplaces like Amazon, eBay, Facebook, etc need a platform to automate and monitor retail, inventory and shipping processes and performance. We have teams across North America and Europe, and we are backed by Marlin Equity Partners, a leading growth equity firm headquartered out of California. Linnworks not only has the market-leading product for e-commerce automation but also attracts the best people in the industry. Highly skilled, passionate, and collaborative with a winning and customer-centric attitude - we pride ourselves on our people.  
  
Life at Linnworks:  
  
Linnworks is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer (EoE). We believe that diversity of experience, perspectives, and background leads to a better environment for our employees and better service for our customers. We value the training and development of our employees deeply. We are committed to continuous investment in their personal growth, providing clear paths for career progression, and equipping them with the tools and training required to become experts in their profession.

jobs.title: Client Onboarding & Growth Specialist (Med Spa Industry)
jobs.description:
**Client Onboarding & Growth Specialist**

Holistic Money | Remote (U.S. Eastern hours) | Full-time | $23 to $26 per hour plus PTO and bonus

**Read this first**

Holistic Money is a fast-growing startup. This is the first hire in a brand new department. You will carry real responsibility from week one, help build the process and the team, and grow as fast as the business does. We are not looking for the most experienced person. We are looking for the hungriest one.

**This is you**

* You want the most out of life, and you are not waiting for someone to hand it to you
* You push yourself. When something is hard, you lean in
* You are ambitious, well spoken, and confident on camera
* You take pride in how you show up: on time, prepared, and put together
* You get a kick out of a client saying yes

**Who we are**

Holistic Money provides Fractional CFO services and bookkeeping to fast-growing med spas. Our clients are female founders: the women owners and injectors you already know. If you have worked in a med spa, you understand them better than most finance people ever will.

**What you will do**

* Be the main point of contact for every new client from "yes" to "live"
* Lead onboarding calls on Zoom: collect logins, connect bank and EMR accounts, set expectations
* Work a checklist and chase missing items until the client is fully set up
* Explain what is happening in plain English and make the first month feel calm and professional
* Spot clients who are ready for a higher service tier and lead that conversation. You earn a bonus every time one says yes
* Hand off cleanly to the bookkeeping and CFO team, and turn every repeated question into a template or FAQ

**What we are looking for**

* Experience working in a med spa or aesthetics practice (front desk, patient coordinator, practice manager, sales). Years do not matter. Knowing the world does
* No bookkeeping or finance background required. We will teach you the finance side; we cannot teach you the industry
* Warm but not a pushover. You can kindly hold a client to a deadline
* Detail-oriented, comfortable with Zoom, Google Drive, Slack, and a project management tool
* Consistent availability for scheduled calls on U.S. Eastern time

**Pay**

$23 to $26 per hour, full time, with paid time off, plus an uncapped bonus for every client you move from our lowest tier to our highest. The people who do this well will out-earn the base quickly. If you want a high starting rate and a quiet desk, this is not the role. If you want a place to prove yourself and grow fast, apply.

**How to apply**

Send your resume and a short video to info@holistic-money.com (two minutes or less) telling us why you want this role and what you learned working in a med spa. We want to see you on camera before we ever get on a call.

Pay: $23.00 - $26.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Paid time off
* Work from home

Application Question(s):

* The first step of the process is to send a 2 minute video presentation of yourself explaining your background and why you're interested in the role. Please send to info@holistic-money.com . Candidates will not be considered if you do not complete this step. If you have sent your video, please reply yes to this question.

jobs.title: Client Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
***Our Mission***
=================

*ButterflyMX is on a mission to empower people to automate property access, operations, and security from a single platform. Our products are installed in more than 20,000+ multifamily, commercial, gated communities, and student-housing properties worldwide, including properties developed, owned, and managed by the most trusted names in real estate. Our features are designed for developers, owners, property managers, and tenants and our products lower operating costs and improve tenant satisfaction*.

***Our Solution***
==================

*Developers and owners no longer need to run building wiring or install in-unit hardware. Property managers can grant building access, revoke permissions, and review entry logs from an online dashboard. Residents can open doors from their smartphones, issue visitor access, and see who is trying to enter the building.*

***Our Culture & Values***
==========================

*Fantastic people are the key to our success. As a distributed, primarily remote workforce, we’re looking for more intelligent, passionate, collaborative, ai-forward, and down-to-earth individuals to join our growing team. We’re driven by a shared commitment to excellence and innovation, grounded in our core values: We delight our customers, We take ownership, We are a community of collaborators, We speak up, We think big and do small, and We are tenacious.*

**Role Overview**
=================

ButterflyMX is seeking a Client Onboarding Specialist to help new and existing clients successfully onboard, understand, and use our products. This client-facing role combines thoughtful communication, strong organization, and technical aptitude to create a smooth onboarding experience.

You will work directly with clients to coordinate onboarding activities, provide training, support product setup and integrations, and address questions along the way. You will partner across internal teams to keep work moving, maintain visibility into open requests, and help clients feel confident using ButterflyMX.

Success in this role requires ownership, attention to detail, and consistent follow-through. You will manage multiple priorities, solve problems as they arise, and help improve the processes and resources that make client onboarding more effective as we scale.

**Responsibilities**
====================

* Guide new and existing clients through onboarding by communicating key steps, setting clear expectations, and helping teams understand how to use ButterflyMX solutions through email, phone, and video support.
* Simultaneously onboard multiple projects and clients, maintaining clear communication and timely follow-through.
* Provide initial and refresher training on ButterflyMX products, administrative tools, and relevant features.
* Support clients through product setup, integrations, troubleshooting, onboarding challenges, and engaging internal teams when needed.
* Maintain accurate records, ticket updates, and onboarding documentation to ensure work is visible and actionable.

================

* Experience using Zendesk or another ticketing platform to manage client requests, document interactions, and track resolutions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to nontechnical audiences.
* Excellent organization, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple requests and priorities.
* Strong problem-solving skills and technical aptitude, with the ability to quickly learn new products, systems, and integrations.
* A proactive, ownership-oriented approach with reliable follow-through and sound judgment.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with internal teams and client stakeholders.
* Maintain a professional, client-focused presence by keeping your camera on during scheduled video calls with clients, fostering engagement, building rapport, and delivering an exceptional onboarding experience.
* Knowledge of property management, proptech, or hardware-enabled SaaS is a plus.
* Proven experience with leveraging AI tools in both professional and personal settings.
* ButterflyMX is an AI-forward organization, and the ability to optimize efficiency using AI is crucial in every role.

**Compensation**
================

The expected base salary range for this position is $30-35/hr. Actual compensation will depend on factors including budget, skills, experience, location, and internal equity. This position may also be eligible for bonuses, equity, or other forms of compensation, where applicable.

**Benefits**
============

* Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision plans (ButterflyMX covers 80% of the cost) starting day 1
* 401(k) plan with a match
* 10 paid holidays, 20 vacation days, 5 sick days, 3 floating holidays
* Basic Life and Accidental Death and Dismemberment Insurance (ButterflyMX covers 100% of the cost)
* Short and Long Term Disability (ButterflyMX covers 100% of the cost)
* Paid Family Leave
* Employee Assistance Program
* Quarterly self-care stipends
* Access to optional benefits including pre-tax flexible healthcare spending accounts (FSA and HSA), Dependent Care FSA, and Commuter Benefits, as well as optional Supplemental Life, AD&D, Hospital Indemnity, Legal, Accident, Critical Illness, Pet, and Personal Liability Insurance
* And more!

*ButterflyMX is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. You must have the authorization to work in the US to become an employee. We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates and employees. If you need reasonable accommodations during the application or the recruiting process, please let our recruiting team know.*

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist (approx 3 month assignment)
jobs.description:
**About the role**
------------------

We're hiring a temporary Implementation Specialist for approximately 3 months to get new clients live on Foureyes products. You'll own each setup from enrollment through launch, so every account is configured, tested, and ready to go.

You'll sit on the Technical Support team and work closely with Sales, Support, and Product. This is a hands-on role: you'll do the setup work yourself and keep dealers and our internal teams updated along the way.

**What you'll do**
------------------

You'll be the person who gets new clients across the finish line, from the day they enroll to the day they're live.

* Own each setup from start to finish across every Foureyes product, keeping track of each store and each step so nothing stalls along the way
* Configure our technical implementations (integrations, data feeds, tracking, and the rest), then test and validate them so every client launches with a setup we can stand behind
* Give internal stakeholders a daily update on progress, blockers, and timelines so Sales, Support, and Product always know where things stand
* Follow up with dealers consistently to get what's needed from them and wrap up setup on time

**What you bring**
------------------

* 2 to 4 years in implementation, onboarding, technical operations, or another customer-facing technical role
* Comfort with technical systems, data feeds, and integrations (CRM experience is a plus)
* Working knowledge of SQL
* Clear written and verbal communication
* Strong organization and attention to detail, with the ability to run several implementations at once
* Analytical problem solving and data validation skills
* The ability to follow a structured process, spot where it could be better, and hit deadlines in a fast-moving environment
* SaaS experience preferred
* Bonus points for automotive technology experience

**Please note that the candidate selected will be payrolled through a third-party staffing partner, and won’t be a regular Foureyes employee.**

**Job type:** Contract (1099) · Part-time  
**Location:** Remote – United States only

**About Us**

We’re a growing digital marketing agency serving the network marketing space. We help our clients launch Facebook and Instagram ad campaigns that generate leads and booked calls, supported by GoHighLevel CRM systems.

We’re looking for a polished, client-facing specialist to own the first stage of our client experience. This is an independent contractor role. It starts part-time, and for the right person there’s a clear path to more hours and responsibility.

**About the Role**

This is not a behind-the-scenes position. You’ll lead Zoom calls with our clients and be the face of our onboarding and launch process. Professionalism, patience, and clear communication are essential.

**Responsibilities**

*Onboarding calls (about 75 minutes)*

* Walk clients through creating their Facebook advertising assets: Business Manager, Business Page, Ad Account, and Pixel
* Share those assets to our company Business Manager (this is not an ads management role, but you should have basic Ads Manager experience)
* Troubleshoot Meta policy, access, and Identity Verification issues live on the call
* Handle GoHighLevel admin tasks: connecting domains, setting up email senders, and submitting A2P / Toll-Free verifications

*Pre-launch calls (about 30 minutes)*

* Prepare clients for what happens once their ads go live, including how leads come in, how calls get booked, and what to expect in the first few weeks
* Show clients how to manage leads and booked calls in their GoHighLevel pipeline
* Answer common questions about our ad process and explain how weekly lead reporting works (we’ll fully train you on our process and talking points)

*Growth opportunity*

* For the right fit, this role can expand into more client support and project management as we scale

**Qualifications**

* Located in the United States and available during business hours
* Extensive hands-on experience with Meta Business Manager and GoHighLevel
* Basic working knowledge of Facebook Ads Manager
* Experience working directly with clients, not just back-office agency work
* Confident and polished on video calls
* Able to explain technical steps simply to non-technical clients
* Organized, reliable, and able to represent a brand without hand-holding

jobs.title: Claims Training Specialist
jobs.description:
### **Help Shape the Future of Claims Learning**

  

We're seeking an experienced property claims professional to help build and deliver technical learning programs that strengthen claim handling quality, compliance, customer outcomes, and associate development.

In this role, you'll combine deep claims expertise with training, coaching, and quality analysis to identify performance opportunities, develop learning solutions, and influence claims excellence across the organization.

  
  

### **What You'll Do**

  

**Build Learning Solutions**

* Design and develop technical training, job aids, claim scenarios, assessments, and learning resources.
* Translate audit findings, regulatory changes, and business initiatives into practical learning solutions.
* Support onboarding, continuing education, and performance improvement programs.
  

  

**Deliver Training & Develop Talent**

* Facilitate engaging instructor-led and virtual learning experiences.
* Lead technical claims, compliance, quality, and operational training initiatives.
* Serve as a trusted resource supporting associate growth and capability development.
  

  

**Identify Opportunities for Improvement**

* Conduct claim file audits and quality reviews to assess adherence to claim handling standards, policy provisions, and regulatory requirements.
* Analyze trends, performance gaps, and root causes to identify development opportunities.
* Provide actionable recommendations that improve quality, compliance, and operational performance.
  

  

**Measure Impact**

* Evaluate training effectiveness through audits, assessments, feedback, and performance results.
* Monitor improvement efforts and continuously refine learning content and delivery methods.
* Provide leadership with insights on trends, risks, and learning outcomes.
  

  

**Partner Across Claims**

* Collaborate with Claims leadership, Quality & Compliance, Operations, and business partners to support organizational goals.
* Support regulatory, system, process, and business transformation initiatives.
* Serve as a subject matter expert on claims quality, compliance, and learning effectiveness.
  

  

**Required Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* **Adjuster license is required.**
* 5+ years of property claims or related P&C insurance experience.
* Strong knowledge of policy interpretation, coverage analysis, claim investigation, settlement practices, and regulatory compliance.
* Experience conducting claim audits, quality reviews, compliance reviews, coaching, or performance improvement activities.
* Experience developing, facilitating, or delivering training and knowledge-transfer initiatives.
* Working knowledge of claims systems and estimating platforms such as Xactimate.
* Strong communication, facilitation, analytical, and organizational skills.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree.
* Homeowners or property claims expertise.
* Experience in quality assurance, compliance, audit, or learning and development functions.
* Instructional design, training, coaching, quality, or compliance certifications.
* Experience with Workday Learning and SharePoint.
* Experience supporting large-scale operational or organizational change initiatives.
* Xactimate Level 1 certification
  

  
  

### **Why Consider This Opportunity?**

This newly created role offers the opportunity to help build a long-term technical claims learning capability, influence claims quality and compliance, and make a broad organizational impact without direct people management. The role is ideal for a highly respected claims professional looking to leverage their expertise in a new way while helping shape the future of claims development.

jobs.title: System Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
Description:

The System Implementation Coordinator is a PRN position that supports the planning, setup, testing, and rollout of clinical and business systems across CUC America. The position works with operations, clinical staff, revenue cycle teams, IT, and vendors to translate operational needs into practical workflows and prepare staff to use new systems effectively.

The role provides hands-on implementation support for electronic medical records, practice management, imaging, reporting, and related technology. Responsibilities extend from requirements gathering through go-live and stabilization, with priorities and project scope established by the reporting leader.

Requirements:

**Essential Responsibilities**

**Implementation Planning and Coordination**

* Maintain implementation work plans, task owners, milestones, dependencies, and readiness checklists for assigned systems and locations.
* Coordinate vendor meetings and internal work sessions; document decisions, follow up on commitments, and escalate delays or unresolved issues.
* Provide regular status updates identifying completed work, upcoming activities, risks, and decisions needed from leadership.

**System Setup and Workflow Development**

* Gather requirements from clinical, administrative, and billing teams; document current workflows and proposed changes for approval.
* Support approved system configuration, including provider and location records, scheduling templates, forms, user roles, and documentation workflows.
* Develop standard operating procedures and workflow guides that connect system use with day-to-day clinic and office-based laboratory operations.

**Testing and Data Validation**

* Develop and execute test scenarios covering registration, scheduling, clinical documentation, results, charge capture, and reporting, as applicable.
* Coordinate data conversion and interface testing with IT and vendors; validate sample records and track discrepancies through resolution.
* Maintain an issue log, retest corrections, and document test results and outstanding items for the responsible owners to review before launch.

**Training and Go Live Support**

* Coordinate role-specific training and prepare user guides, quick reference materials, and training completion records.
* Support readiness assessments and cutover planning, including user access, support contacts, downtime procedures, and open issue review.
* Provide go-live support, troubleshoot workflow and user issues within assigned access, and route technical issues to IT or vendors.
* Track post-launch issues and adoption needs; coordinate the transition to routine operational and technical support.

Reporting and Process Improvement

* Document reporting requirements and approved metric definitions; validate report and dashboard outputs against source records.
* Identify workflow gaps affecting documentation, charge capture, billing handoffs, or data quality and coordinate approved corrections with process owners.
* Maintain project documentation, configuration records, and lessons learned to support consistent implementation at future locations.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Associate or bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, health information technology, information systems, business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* At least two years of experience supporting healthcare system implementations, application support, clinical informatics, or healthcare operations involving system changes. Proposed minimum for confirmation.
* Experience documenting workflows, coordinating project tasks, testing system functionality, and supporting or training end users.
* Working knowledge of clinical and administrative workflows, including scheduling, documentation, and charge capture; ability to identify and escalate workflow risks.
* Strong organization, written communication, troubleshooting, and follow-through; ability to manage concurrent priorities and work effectively with vendors and staff.

**Preferred**

* Experience with electronic medical records, practice management systems, imaging systems, revenue cycle applications, or reporting tools in specialty practices or office-based laboratories.
* Clinical background, healthcare informatics training, or a project management certification. RN licensure and graduate degrees are not proposed as minimum requirements for this implementation role.
